It took me two months to register as a new patient, and I had to call to kindly ask the staff to review my form more quickly, as I was running out of meds. Eventually, I received an invitation for a new patient check-up. I finished my work early that day and arrived at the appointment, only to be told by the nurse that someone had accidentally scheduled a 5-minute slot instead of the 30 minutes required to complete all the checks. The receptionist advised me that someone would get in touch with me to reschedule, but that never happened. Today, I tried to schedule an appointment in the morning, with a 30-minute wait, but had no success. Currently, I've been on the phone for 45 minutes, and nobody is answering.

Update:
I called at 08:00 am on Monday and was already 20th in the queue. I finally received a callback at 09:36 am, and the receptionist told me to call at 08:00 am next time - which I had already done, though I didn’t want to argue while feeling so unwell. She began diagnosing me over the phone, insisting my symptoms were caused by a virus, which a doctor later confirmed was incorrect as I ended up needing antibiotics. This practice is clearly overcrowded with such limited appointments, and receptionists are not qualified to diagnose anyone - that's the doctor’s job.

This is certainly the worst GP practice I have ever been registered
